sources.title: eduardoworrel/ct0-alias3-micro-mlc · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MLC-compiled weights of aliasrobotics/alias3-micro-1026 (CT0 — a 4B hybrid qwen3_5_text: 24 Gated-DeltaNet linear-attention + 8 full-attention layers) for in-browser inference via WebLLM (WebGPU). Only MLC weights + tokenizer here. All model weights, training and credit belong to the original authors — see the source model; its license applies. The ONNX/ort-web path for this model is capped by the browser's ~4 GB WASM limit (forcing an int4 embedding hack).
